mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeded 3.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS declined for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production below 105, manufacturing supply constraints intensify, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO was below 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over the prior month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increased for the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a contraction in residential construction that dampens economic activity and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST was below 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low federal funds rate below 2.0%, the Federal Reserve's accommodative stance supports risk-taking and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS was below 2.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and decline in housing starts indicates demand diversification toward non-residential sectors, signaling economic resilience and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS increased and HOUST declined for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
